def solve_sequence(x1, x2, max_n=7):
    x = [x1, x2]
    print(f"Testing start pair ({x1}, {x2})...")
    for i in range(2, max_n):
        # Calculate x_{i+1} using x_i and x_{i-1}
        numerator = x[i-1]**2 + 1
        denominator = x[i-2] + 1
        
        if numerator % denominator != 0:
            print(f"Sequence breaks at n={i}. Calculation: {numerator}/{denominator}")
            return i
        
        x_next = (numerator // denominator) - 1
        
        if x_next <= 0:
             print(f"Sequence breaks at n={i}. x_{i+1} is not positive: {x_next}")
             return i
             
        x.append(x_next)
        print(f"x_{i+1} found: {x_next}. Sequence so far: {x}")
    return max_n
